title: Tied career standings can show one manager as #2
steps: Complete normal Showdown history so Daniel and Nik are level in the career standings, for example 20 career points each.
Open local Career Statistics and Trophy Room.
Read the rank number shown for each manager.
expected: A level career table should rank both managers joint #1, matching the tie-aware V10 ranking path.
actual: The local Career Statistics table and Trophy Room cabinets assign rank from array position, so the two tied managers are displayed as #1 and #2.
root_cause: Both local renderers use index + 1 as the displayed rank instead of a tie-aware rank. The newer V10 path already checks standings[index].level and assigns rank 1 to a level table.
checked_against: js/careerScreensV10.js:35-38 v10Ranks explicitly ranks a level table joint first.
js/trophyRoom.js:63-115 and 246-247 local cabinet rank rendering.

fix.change: Use the same tie-aware career rank supplied by the standings model, or compute equal ranks for equal career totals, instead of displaying index + 1.

assumptions: A tied career total is a level table and should display joint first, as the V10 code explicitly states.
Local career screens remain part of normal play for the local route.
